name: How long does it take to install a handheld showerhead?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a handheld showerhead?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for handheld showerhead installation can vary. A straightforward replacement on an existing shower arm often takes between 30 minutes to an hour for an experienced professional. If plumbing modifications are necessary, such as installing a new wall bracket that requires drilling into tile or rerouting pipes, the process could extend to several hours. For a general contractor, most standard installations are completed within a single service visit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard installation takes 30 minutes to an hour. More complex installations with plumbing modifications can take several hours.
